list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation Network and cross-checked on PSNProfiles and Exophase (18 Nov 2026). Names, descriptions and grades are the official text; every guide below is written in our own words and names its source.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx trophy guide, via GTA Zone

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Plan around the long tail, not the story: PowerPyx rates the whole set about 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty, and the last trophies standing are almost always A Long Road (100% completion) and the big counters such as 250 stunts. Use the Platinum Path planner in this guide to work in chapter order and save the clean-up for after the credits. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; PowerPyx via GTA Zone for the 200-hour estimate.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn — just play through the opening as directed and it unlocks at the mission's end. Story trophies cannot be missed: with no mission replay at launch, the story itself is linear, so every chapter trophy comes from playing on. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Before you leave the chapter, take the one missable-adjacent step in the whole list: PowerPyx flags a meditation spot at Jason's house in Chapter 1 that may count toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears once the chapter ends. Do that meditation, keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, then finish the chapter and this trophy pops. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; PowerPyx via GTA Zone for the Chapter 1 meditation warning.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. From this chapter on, Jason and Lucia are both playable together, which opens up most of the duo trophies — Hot Together and Retail Therapy need the two of them side by side, so start pairing up once the chapter is done. Keep a manual save at the chapter start: there is no mission replay, so a fresh save per chapter is the safety net the guides recommend. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; LFCarry platinum guide for the duo-play opening in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The robbery trophies open up in Chapters 3 and 4, so from here on, try the armored-truck, bank-vault and illegal-operation robberies as they appear rather than leaving them all for the post-game. Nothing in the chapter itself can be missed. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Output Lag trophy list for the Chapters 3–4 robbery window.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. By now the map is fully open and the robbery and exploration trophies are all available, so use the chapter break to check the tracker: tick off the chapter trophies, then sweep the collectible and activity counters before the finale. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission — this is one of only two gold trophies in the list. Make a manual save before the finale: guides agree there is no mission replay, and the relationship between Jason and Lucia shapes which of the two endings you see, so a pre-finale save lets you see the other ending without a second full playthrough. After the credits the 100% completion checklist appears under Progress, and free roam opens for the clean-up. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square for the post-story 100% checklist; LFCarry for the two-endings note.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock by finishing the named mission; none of them can be missed, since the story is linear and every mission is required. If a mission trophy has not popped, the mission is simply not finished yet. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. This is a story-mission trophy, so it comes from playing the mission to completion — no side requirement, no missable step. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A straight story-mission trophy: finish the mission and it unlocks. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission to earn it — no extra objective is attached. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A story-mission trophy: play the mission through to its end. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy follows — nothing else is required. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the second gold trophy and, by every guide's account, the hardest one. Push Square explains the checklist appears under Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion after the story, and progress made before the credits already counts. The checklist is lenient: for example only 15 of the 18 collectible-card sets are needed for 100%, and the thresholds are roughly 60% of true completion. Work it in order: story first, then the card sets, the 70-of-80 challenges, vehicles and animals, and sweep the leftovers in free roam. Nothing on the checklist is missable. Sources: Push Square trophy guide; PowerPyx via GTA Zone.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Push Square counts 397 stunts in the game, so you need a little over half of them — jumps, near misses, airtime and the rest, tracked in-game under Progress. Fold stunts into normal travel instead of grinding them in one sitting: take jumps and ramps whenever you drive between missions and the counter climbs on its own. Sources: Push Square trophy guide (397 stunts in total); official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — the count comes from the official list's tracked progress. Activities include the shooting range, drone races, racing, fishing, arcade games, bowling and meditation, so this trophy is really a tour of the side content: sample one of each as you meet it and it pops early. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The range is one of the activity types, and the count is tracked on the official list — 42 separate challenges to gold. Work through them weapon by weapon, replaying any challenge that lands silver until it turns gold; there is no time limit and the range stays open after the story. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase (42 challenges); Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Drone races are a repeatable activity: visit each location, win its race, and move on. Losing a race costs nothing — retry it until you win. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Races are spread across the map and unlock as activities; work through the race list and tick each win off in the tracker. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activity types — take the challenge against Cal and out-fish him. If you lose, challenge him again; it is repeatable and not missable. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade machine. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you enjoy and play it through. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission — the last mission in his stranger-mission strand. Character strands are side content: follow Andy's missions as they appear on the map and finish the strand. None of the character strands is missable; they stay available in free roam after the story. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI achievements tracker.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission — the last mission in his stranger-mission strand. Play through Kenton's missions in order; the strand stays open after the story, so there is no deadline. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI achievements tracker.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission — the last mission in his stranger-mission strand. Follow Billy's missions as they appear and finish the strand in free roam if you prefer. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI achievements tracker.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger strands are the side-mission chains marked on the map — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have one, and three more strangers fill the set. Each strand ends with its own trophy, so finishing 8 strands also earns most of the character trophies on the way. Do them as they appear during the story and mop up the rest after the credits. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI achievements tracker.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission — the last mission in his stranger-mission strand. Play Randy's missions in order; the strand remains available after the story. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI achievements tracker.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission — the last mission in his stranger-mission strand. Follow Tyrone's missions as they appear; nothing here is missable. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI achievements tracker.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across Leonida, with Jason and Lucia — GTA Zone counts 18 spots in 10 locations. This is the ONE trophy every guide flags as possibly missable: PowerPyx reports that the first spot is offered by Lucia on her balcony in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, and that offer is gone once Chapter 1 ends. It is not confirmed whether the trophy needs that spot, but PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it — so take it when it comes, before finishing Chapter 1. The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note: 100% completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so even in the worst case this cannot cost you A Long Road. Sources: PowerPyx via GTA Zone; WikiGTAVI.
trophies.missableNote: Possibly missable — one meditation spot is offered in Chapter 1 only (PowerPyx, unconfirmed whether it counts). Do it before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is a hunting side task: find the unique animal Bret asks for and take it down. Animals are studied and tracked in-game, so use the animal-tracking tools as you explore and this comes naturally during the exploration sweep. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible-card sets. Push Square counts 18 card sets in the game, and 100% completion needs 15 of them — so this silver is a milestone on the way to A Long Road, not a separate grind. Pick up cards as you explore; each set you complete is tracked under Progress. Sources: Push Square trophy guide (18 sets, 15 for 100%); official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK It is a photo/check-in style collectible activity: visit a location, use it, and move on. It pairs well with the exploration sweep for The Goodtime State — do both together, area by area, and the counter climbs fast. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are split into 8 categories of 10 — Combat, Vehicle and the rest — and they are all available from the start of the game. They also feed 100% completion, which needs 70 of the 80 challenges, so treat 50 as the halfway mark on the way to A Long Road. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; GTA Zone / PowerPyx for the 8-categories-of-10 split.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Both characters must be playable together, which opens after Chapter 2 — so try it once the duo is unlocked. Lose the cops by breaking line of sight and getting out of the search area, the classic GTA escape. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; LFCarry platinum guide.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of Hot Together: keep the heat, don't lose it. Plan a short route between three shops, rob each in turn, and stay ahead of the police between stops. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; LFCarry platinum guide.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles are scanned or driven to register them — explore the map, drive anything new you see, and the counter rises. It overlaps with the 100% checklist, which asks for 200 of the 277 vehicles, so keep scanning past 100. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; LFCarry platinum guide (200 of 277 for 100%).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-aim ability: trigger it in a busy fight, pick off five enemies before it ends, and the trophy pops. A crowded shootout or a police chase gives you the targets — line up the shots while time is slowed. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the Vice City airport. The description is deliberately vague, and the guides group this with Challenging Tank as a robbery-and-heat one-off: get to the airport and leave in a way the airport did not schedule, in a plane rather than through the terminal. No confirmed step-by-step method was published at launch, so treat the description itself as the instruction and check Push Square's guide as the community pins it down. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI (grouped with the heat trophies).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a joke with no literal instruction — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' points at the Rhino tank. The guides place it with the robbery-and-heat group: get into a Rhino tank and cause the chaos the name implies. No confirmed method was published at launch; the trophy is earned in free roam, so it cannot be missed. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI (robbery-and-heat group).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery. Scout the store, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails for this trophy, so leave and retry rather than fighting through it. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the big robberies — plan the getaway before you go in, and escape cleanly after each one. Five successful vault robberies earn the silver. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks roam the roads — intercept one, take its cargo and get away before the police close in. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape much easier. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map is split into 52 named areas — drive or fly through each one and the area registers. Pair this with the WAiNK It sweep and the vehicle-discovery sweep: one area-by-area tour covers three trophies at once. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 9 gangs with operations across Leonida — hit one operation per gang. Track which gangs you have done in the checklist so you don't repeat one and miss another. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method was published at launch — only the official description is known. The description itself is the instruction: go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and have a cocktail there. This is one of the five unconfirmed secret trophies the guides list; check Push Square or WikiGTAVI as players confirm the exact spot. It cannot be missed — Ocean Beach is open from the start. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI (lists this among the five unconfirmed secrets).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method was published at launch — only the official description is known. The description points at a vehicle showroom: drive a car through the showroom glass in classic GTA style. This is one of the five unconfirmed secret trophies; check Push Square or WikiGTAVI as the community confirms which showroom and how. It is a free-roam stunt, so it cannot be missed. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a game there. Bowling is one of the activity types, and the alley is a named location on the map. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method was published at launch — only the official description is known. The wording suggests a duo moment with mass appeal, likely with your partner in a public place. This is one of the five unconfirmed secret trophies; check Push Square or WikiGTAVI as players confirm it. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The official list tracks a count of 500 for this trophy — make choices, 500 of them, for better or worse. Choices appear throughout the story and side content: dialogue picks, activity choices and the small decisions the game keeps count of. It accumulates passively across a full playthrough, so don't chase it early; check the count under Progress and it will be near done by the time you finish the clean-up. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase (500 count); LFCarry platinum guide (choice-driven, save before major decisions).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method was published at launch — only the official description is known. 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt — a failed activity retried, or a second try at a one-off moment. This is one of the five unconfirmed secret trophies; check Push Square or WikiGTAVI as the community confirms it. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method was published at launch — only the official description is known. 'What the hell just happened?' points at witnessing something strange — a random world event or an odd encounter somewhere in Leonida. This is one of the five unconfirmed secret trophies; check Push Square or WikiGTAVI as players find the trigger. Keep exploring and it will find you. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method was published at launch — only the official description is known. A melee drive-by means striking someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — 'bowl 'em over' like a bowling strike. This is one of the five unconfirmed secret trophies; check Push Square or WikiGTAVI as the community confirms the exact conditions. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WikiGTAVI.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations — and your contacts clean them for you. It accumulates across the whole game, so keep robbing and laundering; the robbery trophies feed this one directly. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, vehicles, food, anything the shops sell. It counts across every shop, so normal spending across a full playthrough gets most of the way there; top it up with a big purchase at the end, such as a vehicle or a property. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are property purchases — buy each one as you can afford it. They double as storage for the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so buy garages early and fill them as you go. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, register them in the app, and repeat until ten are in. It pairs with Whip It Good (discover 100 vehicles) — register the most interesting ten as you discover them. Sources: official PS5 list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: On the Spot
